verdict.rationale: Teller documents a transactions API that exposes an account's ledger transactions, and its list endpoint supports pagination controls. A community member also reports using the API to export account data. However, nothing documents how far back history goes. Webhooks fire on changes to financial data, but no incremental or delta sync pattern for fetching only changed transactions is described. Missing for 10: documented history depth, an explicit sync/delta mechanism for changed transactions, detailed pagination semantics.
